# looker_role (Data Source)

Looks up a Looker role by name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "looker_role" "example" {
  name = "Marketing Viewer"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the role. Matched case-insensitively.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `model_set_id` (String)
- `permission_set_id` (String)
